case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your proposal for a 24-month contract, as it provides valuable stability for both our companies. Our foundry has always valued long-standing partnerships, and this reliable perspective means a great deal to our team.

However, an effective date of April 2027 is too far out given the ongoing cost pressures; we propose January 2027 instead. In recognition of this longer commitment, we are prepared to reduce our price to a price of €51.80 per unit, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027.

Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and the movement you have shown, which brings us closer together.

In the spirit of our long-standing partnership, we are prepared to make a further concession to €50.90 per unit for the 24-month contract starting in April 2027. Our specific terms for this proposal are a price of €50.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

I am confident this fair step will allow us to conclude our negotiations successfully. It is always a pleasure working together with your respected house, and my team in the foundry remains dedicated to delivering the high quality you expect from us.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
